name: ToolMem
what_evolved: Context记忆与提示 (learnable tool-capability memory storing each tool's strengths/weaknesses)
skill_as_artifact: Yes; natural-language capability-insight memory entries per tool, structured by proficiency category
skill_encoding: 自然语言 (NL knowledge entries describing tool properties, optionally tagged with numerical proficiency measures)
skill_granularity: 见解(insight) - tool-capability insights summarizing strengths/weaknesses
how_method: reward-based (numeric/NL quality feedback) via non-gradient text-space memory induction & refinement by an LLM Memory Induction Module (ILM)
learning_signal_source: LLM-as-judge (text generation) + human annotations (image generation); outcome quality feedback per interaction
reward_granularity: outcome (per-interaction quality score / critique on tool output)
learning_paradigm: offline (memory accumulated from previous interactions); on-policy (agent's own experiences)
when_evolve: inter-test-time (memory developed across tasks from prior interactions, applied at inference)
trigger: event-triggered (each new interaction experience triggers memory induction + dynamic refinement)
library_structure: 层次化 (proficiency categories: proficient/good/bad/weak) + 向量库 (embedding index per category)
retrieval_method: 语义相似度 (cosine embedding similarity, top-k retrieval via text-embedding-ada-002)
validation: execution-based (quality feedback on tool outputs) + held-out evaluation (MAE/RMSE/Pearson for prediction, F1/Acc for selection)
error_correction: self-revision (ILM refines memory: adds novel insights, updates incomplete, removes redundant, merges related entries)
test_env: tool-call / 通用 (text generation on BIGGEN-Bench & text-to-image generation on GENAI-BENCH)
metrics: MAE/RMSE/Pearson correlation (tool-performance prediction); F1 & Accuracy (optimal tool selection)
key_results: Tool-performance prediction 14.8% (text) & 28.7% (image) more accurate vs generic agent; +76.7% Pearson correlation avg; optimal tool selection +21% (text) & +24% (image) absolute; boosts small models (Qwen1.5-0.5B Pearson -0.007→0.405)
limitations: scalability (memory maintenance; explicitly noted as future work); transferability (only text & image-gen tools; extending to wider tools is future work); feedback-mechanism reliance (human annotations needed for image generation)
